cases.title: Verify initial paused state and play/pause toggling via video element and button
cases.description: Ensure the video player starts in a paused state, displays '►', and toggles play/pause status correctly when clicking either the video element (class='viewer') or the toggle-play-button. Verify icon switches to '❚ ❚' when playing and stabilizes correctly under rapid clicks.

cases.title: Verify skip backward and skip forward buttons functionality and boundary limits
cases.description: Verify that clicking Skip Backward data-testid='skip-backward-button' rewinds the video by 10 seconds and Skip Forward data-testid='skip-forward-button' fast-forwards by 25 seconds using data-skip attributes. Ensure currentTime never drops below 0 or exceeds the video's total duration.

cases.title: Verify volume slider updates video volume and handleRangeUpdate behavior
cases.description: Verify that interacting with the volume slider (data-testid='volume-slider') updates the video's audio level between 0 and 1 in increments of 0.05 via handleRangeUpdate, updating the UI in real-time.

cases.title: Verify playback rate slider controls speed and rejects out-of-range values
cases.description: Ensure the playback rate slider (data-testid='playback-rate-slider') modifies the video speed from 0.5x to 2x in 0.05 increments, starting at 1x. Verify that invalid values (e.g., 3) are rejected and the video maintains its last valid speed.

cases.title: Verify progress bar tracking, completion, reset, and manual scrubbing
cases.description: Verify that the progress bar width correctly calculates playback progress using (currentTime / duration) * 100, fills during playback, reaches 100% on completion, resets to 0% on restart, and responds to manual click/drag scrubbing.

cases.title: Verify fullscreen button toggles fullPlayer class on the player element
cases.description: Ensure clicking the fullscreen button (data-testid='fullscreen-button') toggles the 'fullPlayer' class on the player element regardless of the current viewing mode.

opinions.feedback: All high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover the requirements comprehensively, and are fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Normal path is video starts paused, clicking class='viewer' or data-testid='toggle-play-button' toggles play/pause, icon displays '►' when paused and '❚ ❚' when playing. Boundary: rapid clicks stabilize in final state. Abnormal: events 'click', 'play', 'pause' mismatch or out-of-sync states. R-2: Normal path is skip backward by 10s via data-testid='skip-backward-button' and forward by 25s via data-testid='skip-forward-button' using data-skip. Boundary: currentTime constrained between 0 and video duration. Abnormal: negative time or duration overflow attempts. R-3: Normal path is volume slider data-testid='volume-slider' updates video.volume from 0 to 1 in 0.05 steps via handleRangeUpdate. Boundary: values at exact bounds 0 and 1. Abnormal: values outside 0-1 range. R-4: Normal path is playback rate slider data-testid='playback-rate-slider' updates speed from 0.5x to 2x in 0.05 steps via handleRangeUpdate, default 1. Boundary: min 0.5, max 2. Abnormal: values outside range like 3 rejected, maintaining last valid speed. R-5: Normal path is progress bar width tracks (currentTime / duration) * 100, fills on play, reaches 100% on completion, resets to 0% on restart, manual scrub via clicking/dragging .progress updates currentTime and fill. Boundary: start at 0%, end at 100%. Abnormal: scrubbing outside progress element bounds. R-7: Normal path is fullscreen button data-testid='fullscreen-button' toggles class 'fullPlayer' on class='player' element. Boundary: works from either normal or fullscreen state. Abnormal: missing 'player' class container during toggle.
